name: Show routing table
description: Display this container's routing table. Useful for confirming which interface a subnet is reached through.

name: Show neighbour table
description: The kernel's ARP cache. Under host networking this is the real LAN neighbour table.

name: Route to device
description: Which interface and gateway this container would use to reach an address.

name: Remote uptime
description: Load average and time since boot. No parameters, so no injection surface at all — the safest shape an SSH action can have.

name: Restart a systemd unit
description: Requires a NOPASSWD sudoers entry on the target for each exact unit — see docs/SUDOERS_EXAMPLE.md. The unit is a fixed set of choices rather than free text, because 'systemctl restart <anything>' via sudo is trivially escalatable to root.

unit.description: Edit this list to match the sudoers entries you actually installed

name: Restart a Docker container
description: WARNING: requires the SSH user to be in the docker group, which is root-equivalent on the target — it can mount the host filesystem into a container. Treat this credential as a root credential.

container.description: Container name. The pattern rejects spaces, semicolons, backticks and $().

name: Tail a log file
description: Last N lines of a fixed set of log paths. The path is a choice rather than free text — a free-text path is a directory traversal waiting to happen, and reading arbitrary files over SSH is not a diagnostic.
